Use the attached product image as the exact reference for the 24oz antique decanter; reproduce it photorealistically and do not change its shape, color, material, finish, proportions, or any printed artwork, logo, or text. Composite the product into this scene: an industrial loft bar with exposed brick behind. Style it with a cluster of amber glass bottles and a vintage cocktail shaker arranged naturally nearby. The 24oz antique decanter is placed upright as the centerpiece, rendered at correct real-world scale and seamlessly integrated with matching white balance, color temperature, and perspective. Overall elevated premium-brand feel, in a magazine-quality commercial styling aesthetic. Output a high-resolution, photorealistic commercial product mockup with sharp focus on the product, natural materials and textures, and no added text, watermarks, borders, or duplicate items.
